sources.text: 2026 FAA nationwide ground stop. On November 13, 2026, at 20:54 UTC, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued a nationwide ground stop across the United States due to a communication outage. Originating from and first issued at O'Hare International Airport and Midway International Airport in Chicago, the FAA ordered all airports to immediately ground flights due to "extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety". The ground stop was lifted at 01:15 UTC, four hours and twenty-one minutes later.
